title: lygodium japonicum var. microstachyum
intro: Lygodium japonicum var. microstachyum, commonly known as Japanese climbing fern or Japanese climbing fern (var. microstachyum), is a variety of the Lygodium japonicum plant, a species of climbing fern in the family Lygodiaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Lygodium japonicum var. microstachyum include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant contribute to its potential in treating various health issues and have been studied for their antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
